gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-noticia-text: Bruno Ace SC spaces its letters out like beads on a thread. Noticia Text answers with a serif that has a generous entry into every curve and tall lowercase bodies, so a bigger heading over smaller text would look right.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-piazzolla: Bruno Ace SC spreads wide, open letters with no pen-style thinning across the heading, and Piazzolla follows in a classic serif with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Refined authority is what they share.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-pridi: Bruno Ace SC strings its open letters out in a wide line. Pridi, a classic serif with proud, nearly capital-sized small letters and generous gaps where curves meet stems, would carry a longer passage with a dignified, unhurried feel.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-scope-one: Expressive and distinctive, Bruno Ace SC draws every stroke with essentially zero contrast, while Scope One, a classic serif, lets its counters spill out beside a big x-height. One is built for display, the other for reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-slabo-13px: Letters spread like beads on a long thread give Bruno Ace SC its look, all monoline and open. Slabo 13px, a text serif with tall, open a, e and s, makes a long stretch of reading feel bookish and dignified.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified from the first line, Bruno Ace SC spreads out open, unthinned letters above Suwannaphum, a classic serif whose high x-height has a squared-off, woodblock feel. Display and text sit together like headline and column.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-fs-karma: Bold and distinctive, Cabin Sketch draws stout strokes with no swell anywhere, tall little letters pressed flat. And Karma brings a serif with a measured hairline-to-stem swell that finishes trustworthy and classic.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-fs-paquito: Stout, sketchy and rod-like, Cabin Sketch is a single-weight heading that stands out. Paquito, a serif with caps and lowercase nearly the same height, feels confident and approachable over a longer passage, though it was made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-caesar-dressing-fs-paquito: Expressive and distinctive, Caesar Dressing has lowercase standing tall against its capitals. Paquito, a classic serif made for short stretches of reading, simply stays confident and approachable, where the heading font does its showing off.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-archivo: Marker-traced strokes and a towering midzone give Calligraffitti its friendly, graceful look. Archivo, a sans-serif with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, brings an editorial, approachable footing, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
